```{r packages}
# devtools::install_github("synth-inference/synthdid")
library(synthdid)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(12345)
```

# データの読み込み


```{r data}
library(rio)
Data <- rio::import("../../03_data_output/Affiliate/N_affiliate_entry_country_industry_year.dta")

Data$FA_Sector <- Data$FA_SectorCode2009
Data$FA_SectorCode2009 <- NULL

# 2010年から2020年に限定
DataA <- Data[Data$year >= 2010 & Data$year <= 2020, ]


# EU加盟国だけ残す
DataA <- DataA[DataA$EU == 1, ]

# 高所得EUだけ残す
EU_HI <- c("AUT", "BEL", "DNK", "FIN", "FRA", "DEU", "IRL", "ITA", "LUX", "NLD", "SWE", "GBR")
DataA <- DataA[DataA$iso %in% EU_HI, ]

# `iso` と `FA_sector` の組み合わせIDを作成
#DataA <- DataA %>%
#  mutate(pair = group_indices(., iso, FA_Sector))

```


# バランスドパネルを作成

```{r make-balanced-panel}

library(plm)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

DataB <- DataA %>%
  # All combinations of iso - FA_Sector - year
  complete(iso, FA_Sector, year)

# `iso` と `FA_Sector` の組み合わせID
DataB <- DataB %>%
  group_by(iso, FA_Sector) %>%
  mutate(pair = cur_group_id()) %>%
  ungroup()

# `iso` が空の行を削除
DataB <- DataB %>%
  filter(iso != "")
# `FA_Sector == 0` を削除
DataB <- DataB %>%
  filter(FA_Sector != 0)

# バランスドパネルを作成
#DataB <- plm::make.pbalanced(DataA, balance.type = c("fill"), index = c("iso", "year"))

# `N` の欠損を 0 に置換
DataB$N[is.na(DataB$N)] <- 0

```



```{r prepare}

# treated = 1 if iso == "GBR" and year >= 2016
# treated = 0 if iso != "GBR" and year < 2016
DataB$treated <- ifelse(DataB$iso == "GBR" & DataB$year >= 2016, 1, 0)

DataB <- DataB[, c("iso", "year", 
                              "N", "pair", "treated")]

table(DataB$year, DataB$treated)

# `iso` を落とす前に組み合わせ表を保存
pair_iso_map <- unique(DataB[, c("pair", "iso")])

# データフレームに変換
DataB <- as.data.frame(DataB)

# `country`・`year`・`outcome`・`treated` の順に並べる
DataB <- DataB[, c("pair", "year", "N", "treated")]

```



# Synthetic DiDの推定


```{r sdid, message=FALSE,  warning=FALSE}

# Synthetic DiD 用のデータを準備
# `panel.matrices` で wide 形式に変換
setup = synthdid::panel.matrices(DataB, 
                                 unit =1, 
                                 time = 2, 
                                 outcome = 3, 
                                 treatment =4)
# `synthdid_estimate` で SDiD を推定
## Y: matrix of observed values
## N0: number of control group
## T0: number of pretreatment periods
estimateSDiD = synthdid::synthdid_estimate(setup$Y, setup$N0, setup$T0)
estimateSDiD
print(summary(estimateSDiD))

# 分散共分散行列を計算
# Bootstrap 法で標準誤差を計算（set.seed は直前に置く）
set.seed(12345)
seSDiDb = sqrt(vcov(estimateSDiD, method = 'bootstrap'))
# Placebo
seSDiDp = sqrt(vcov(estimateSDiD, method = 'placebo'))
# Jackknife
seSDiDj = sqrt(vcov(estimateSDiD, method = 'jackknife'))

# 観測数 (Unit数)
N_units <- nrow(setup$Y)

```


- `sprintf` is a wrapper for the C function sprintf, that returns a character vector containing a formatted combination of text and variable values.

```{r label}
# sprintf
label_point <- sprintf('Point estimate = %1.3f', estimateSDiD)

label_boot <- sprintf('Bootstrap S.E. = %1.3f, 95%% CI [%1.3f, %1.3f]', 
                       seSDiDb, 
                       estimateSDiD - 1.96 * seSDiDb, 
                       estimateSDiD + 1.96 * seSDiDb)

label_jack <- sprintf('Jackknife S.E. = %1.3f, 95%% CI [%1.3f, %1.3f]', 
                       seSDiDj, 
                       estimateSDiD - 1.96 * seSDiDj, 
                       estimateSDiD + 1.96 * seSDiDj)

label_placebo <- sprintf('Placebo S.E. = %1.3f, 95%% CI [%1.3f, %1.3f]', 
                          seSDiDp, 
                          estimateSDiD - 1.96 * seSDiDp, 
                          estimateSDiD + 1.96 * seSDiDp)

label_n <- sprintf('N = %d', N_units)

label_point
label_boot
label_jack
label_placebo
label_n
```


# 処置効果を図示

```{r Fig9_SDiD, dpi = 300}
# Bootstrap 法による結果をプロット
g1 <- plot(estimateSDiD, se.method = 'bootstrap')

# ラベルをプロット内に追加
g2 <- g1 + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ~ axisTicks(., log = FALSE)) + 
  annotate("text", x = 2016, y = 0.15, label = label_point, size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 2016, y = 0.10, label = label_boot, size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 2016, y = 0.05, label = label_jack, size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 2016, y = 0.00, label = label_placebo, size = 3, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 2016, y = -0.05, label = label_n, size = 3, hjust = 0)

g2
    
# 図を保存
ggsave("../../04_tex/main/Fig9.pdf", dpi = 300,
       width=8, height=6)

```

## ウェイトの確認

```{r weight, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
g_units <- synthdid_units_plot(estimateSDiD, se.method='placebo')
# 対照群ウェイトのデータ
control_weight <- g_units$data

# ウェイトと組み合わせ表を結合
control_weight2 <- merge(control_weight,
                         pair_iso_map,
                         by.x = "unit",
                         by.y = "pair",
                         all.x = TRUE)

# 国別にウェイトを集計
control_weight_country <- control_weight2 %>%
  group_by(iso) %>%
  summarise(weight = sum(weight),
            y = sum(y * weight),
            estimate = first(estimate)
            )

# `countrycode` で国名を付与
library(countrycode)
control_weight_country <- control_weight_country %>%
  mutate(country_name = countrycode(iso,
     origin = "iso3c",
     destination = "country.name")
  )

# 集計済みウェイトを保存
rio::export(control_weight_country, "../../03_data_output/synthdid_control_weight_entry_country.dta")
```
